verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses: 📜
“If anyone sins against Yahweh by dealing dishonestly with a neighbor—over a deposit, a business deal, robbery, or by squeezing them for what’s theirs—⚠️
“or by finding something lost, lying about it, and swearing falsely—any of these wrong moves makes that person guilty. ⚠️
“When the person is found guilty, they must give back whatever they stole, took by oppression, held as a deposit, or found and kept. 🔄
“They must repay the full amount they lied about and add one-fifth more. On the day they’re found guilty, return it to the rightful owner. ⚖️
“Then bring Yahweh a flawless ram from the flock as a guilt offering. Its value must match the priest’s assessment. 🐏
“The priest will make atonement for the person before Yahweh, and they’ll be forgiven for the wrong that made them guilty.” 🕊️
Yahweh spoke to Moses again: 📜
“Give Aaron and his sons these instructions for the burnt offering: let it stay on the altar hearth all night until morning, and keep the altar fire burning. 🔥
“The priest must put on his linen tunic and linen undergarments, clear away the ashes from the burnt offering, and place them beside the altar. 🧹
“Then he must change clothes and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place. 🧹
“Keep the altar fire burning; don’t let it go out. Every morning the priest must add wood, arrange the burnt offering on it, and burn the fat from the peace offerings. 🔥
“Keep the altar fire burning nonstop. Don’t let it go out. 🔥
“Here’s the rule for the grain offering: Aaron’s sons must present it before Yahweh, in front of the altar. 🌾
“The priest will take a handful of fine flour and oil, plus all the frankincense on the offering, and burn it on the altar as its memorial portion—a pleasing aroma to Yahweh. 🔥
“Aaron and his sons may eat what’s left, without yeast, in a holy place—the courtyard of the Meeting Tent. 🍞
“Don’t bake it with yeast. I’ve given it to them as their share of my fire offerings. It’s most holy, like the sin and guilt offerings. 🕊️
“Every male descendant of Aaron may eat this share as a lasting portion through every generation, from Yahweh’s fire offerings. Whoever touches these offerings becomes holy.’ 🙏
Yahweh spoke to Moses again: 📜
“This is the offering Aaron and his sons must bring to Yahweh on the day one is anointed: one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour each day, half in the morning and half in the evening. 🌾
“Mix it with oil and cook it on a griddle. Bring it in as baked pieces, an aroma pleasing to Yahweh. 🍳
“The anointed priest who takes his son’s place must offer it. This lasting rule says the whole offering belongs to Yahweh and must be completely burned. 🔥
“Every grain offering made by a priest must be burned completely. None of it may be eaten.” 🚫
Yahweh spoke to Moses again: 📜
“Tell Aaron and his sons: Here’s the rule for the sin offering. Slaughter it before Yahweh where the burnt offering is slaughtered. It’s most holy. 🩸
“The priest who offers it for sin may eat it in a holy place, in the Meeting Tent courtyard. 🍽️
“Anything that touches its meat becomes holy. If its blood splashes on a garment, wash that garment in a holy place. 💧
“Break the clay pot used to boil it. If it was boiled in a bronze pot, scrub it out and rinse it with water. 🏺
“Every male among the priests may eat from it. It’s most holy. 🙏
“But don’t eat a sin offering if its blood was taken into the Meeting Tent to make atonement in the Holy Place. Burn it with fire instead.” 🔥
